packageRules.description: Group Sigstore Rust crates so their shared pre-1.0 APIs stay aligned.
decmpfs 0.1.2 fails to compile for musl targets (FICLONE ioctl request typed c_ulong, which is c_int on musl). Hold at 0.1.0 until upstream fixes it.
yamlpatch and yamlpath 1.28+ require Rust 1.97 transitively, above the project MSRV.
